comment: OwneetOS optional apps ([[step-5.0.0-optional-web-apps]]; a program: [[step-5.0.1-optional-gaming-apps]]). An engine's packages are in iso/bundled.txt. One app per line: owneet-apps (root) reads the engines' packages without a JSON parser. Only the packages of an engine listed here can be installed or removed by the console user. Names are i18n keys; icons are generic letters (no third-party logos). silentBehindHome: the app goes silent while the home screen is in front of it; no web app has it: video and music apps play on behind the home screen and behind a game, so music or a podcast can go on while playing (owner, 2026-11-23); the emulation program has it, as games do.
